newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: One killed in Austria private plane crash.
newsitem.headline: One killed in Austria private plane crash.

text.p: One man died and a woman was seriously injured when a private plane crashed in mountainous terrain near Austria's border with Switzerland, local rescue services said on Saturday.
The Cessna plane, which disappeared on Friday, was found early on Saturday near the Klostertaler glacier in Vorarlberg, Austria's westernmost province.
Austrian radio said the two people on board, both believed to be from Vienna, were on their way from Budapest to St. Moritz in Switzerland.
